courseDetails.title: SQL Course: Learn SQL from Beginner to Advanced
courseDetails.shortDescription: Master PostgreSQL, MySQL & SQL Server with hands-on SQL queries, JOINs, CTEs, Window Functions & Data Analysis
courseDetails.longDescription:
Learn SQL from beginner to advanced with a practical, step-by-step SQL course designed to help you write real SQL queries, analyze data, work with relational databases, and build confidence using SQL.


Whether you are completely new to SQL or want to strengthen your existing SQL skills, this course takes you from the fundamentals to advanced SQL techniques through hands-on examples, exercises, and real-world database scenarios.


You will learn how to write SQL queries using SELECT, WHERE, ORDER BY, GROUP BY, and HAVING, work with aggregate functions, combine data from multiple tables using JOINs, handle NULL values, use CASE expressions, write subqueries and Common Table Expressions (CTEs), and apply powerful SQL Window Functions.


You will also work with PostgreSQL and learn SQL concepts that transfer to other relational database systems, including MySQL and SQL Server.

By the end of this course, you will be able to write complex SQL queries, analyze relational data, generate reports, work with database objects, and apply SQL to data analysis, business intelligence, database management, and real-world data problems.


What You Will Learn

This SQL course provides a complete learning path from beginner to advanced SQL.

You will learn how to:


  • Write SQL queries to retrieve data from relational databases.

  • Select, filter, sort, and transform data.

  • Work with SQL operators and expressions.

  • Use aggregate functions such as COUNT, SUM, AVG, MIN, and MAX.

  • Group and summarize data using GROUP BY and HAVING.

  • Combine data from multiple tables using SQL JOINs.

  • Work with INNER JOIN, LEFT JOIN, RIGHT JOIN, and FULL JOIN.

  • Handle NULL values using COALESCE and NULLIF.

  • Use CASE expressions for conditional logic.

  • Write and understand subqueries.

  • Create Common Table Expressions (CTEs).

  • Use advanced SQL Window Functions.

  • Work with functions such as ROW_NUMBER, RANK, and DENSE_RANK.

  • Analyze and transform data using SQL.

  • Generate useful reports from relational databases.

  • Work with PostgreSQL.

  • Understand SQL concepts applicable to MySQL and SQL Server.

  • Work with database design and relational database concepts.

  • Apply SQL to practical data-analysis problems.


Beginner to Advanced SQL

The course follows a step-by-step approach.


You will begin with the fundamentals of SQL and relational databases before progressing into more advanced SQL queries and data-analysis techniques.

Topics include SQL syntax, SELECT statements, filtering, sorting, expressions, functions, NULL values, grouping, aggregate functions, JOINs, subqueries, CTEs, Window Functions, conditional logic, regular expressions, and advanced grouping techniques.


SQL for Data Analysis

SQL is one of the most important tools for working with structured data.


Throughout the course, you will learn how to use SQL to retrieve, filter, transform, aggregate, and analyze data. These skills can be applied to data analysis, reporting, business intelligence, database programming, and many other data-related roles.



PostgreSQL, MySQL and SQL Server

The course uses PostgreSQL as an important practical database environment while teaching SQL concepts that are transferable to other relational database management systems.


You will also learn concepts relevant to MySQL and SQL Server, giving you a broader understanding of SQL across different database platforms.


Advanced SQL

As you progress through the course, you will work with advanced SQL features including:


  • Common Table Expressions (CTEs)

  • SQL JOINs

  • Subqueries

  • Window Functions

  • ROW_NUMBER

  • RANK

  • DENSE_RANK

  • CASE expressions

  • NULL handling

  • Regular expressions

  • ROLLUP

  • CUBE

  • GROUPING

  • GROUPING SETS


These techniques allow you to solve increasingly complex SQL and data-analysis problems.


Practical SQL Skills

This is a hands-on SQL course.

Rather than learning SQL only as theory, you will work through practical examples and progressively more advanced SQL queries.


The goal is to help you understand not only how SQL syntax works, but also how to use SQL to solve real-world database and data-analysis problems.


Who Is This Course For?

This course is suitable for:


  • Complete beginners who want to learn SQL.

  • Students looking for a comprehensive SQL course.

  • Developers who need SQL and database skills.

  • Data analysts learning SQL for data analysis.

  • Students preparing to work with relational databases.

  • Professionals who want to strengthen their SQL skills.

  • Learners who want to progress from beginner SQL to advanced SQL.

  • Anyone who wants practical experience writing SQL queries.


Updated for 2026

This course is regularly updated with current examples, practical exercises, and modern SQL learning content.

Our Occupational Therapy Certification course is designed to help you master the skills necessary to become a professional occupational therapist. A professional occupational therapist supports people in overcoming different life challenges.

This course starts with an introductory module that will provide you with an overview of occupational therapy (OT), including its history, the various professions that occupational therapists might work in, and its significance in the healthcare industry. Besides, we will discuss the skills and training you need to have to be a successful occupational therapist.

As you advance through the modules, you will understand the tactics you should use while working with different age groups, such as elderly people and children. You will also get solid skills working with children with developmental disabilities.

Occupational therapists need to be skilled in therapeutic approaches and techniques, which is why we will train you in cognitive behavioral therapy (CBT), sensory integration techniques, and other approaches. Additionally, we will guide you in giving therapy to people suffering from severe depression so that they can regain their lost confidence.

Furthermore, you will explore tactics for coping with life changes, as transitions in life are inevitable. We will guide you on the 4-S model, social support networks, and coping strategies to overcome the transitional situation and restore resilience and growth.

This is not the end, we will guide you to develop your career in occupational therapy through lifelong learning and self-development. In that context, we will share some practical knowledge you need to possess. Moreover, we will aware you of the legal and ethical responsibilities essential for occupational therapy by ensuring your client's privacy and healthcare policies.

Dive into this course to discover more about your career options as an occupational therapist and how you may make a meaningful impact in people's lives through your passion.


Enroll Now!

This course comes with the following Sections:


  1. Introduction to Occupational Therapy: You will explore occupational therapy in detail in this section of the course, including its background and significance in the healthcare sector. In addition to learning the functions of occupational therapy, you will look into multiple fields and possible difficulties that an occupational therapist may encounter.

  2. Essential Knowledge & Skills: This part of our course will teach you about the set of skills and training required to work as an occupational therapist. We will also be aware of your client's rights and how you act accordingly.

  3. Working with Different Age Groups: Here you will know how to apply occupational therapy in different conditions, and effectively work with different age groups, as different age groups have different requirements.

  4. Therapeutic Approaches and Techniques: Throughout this course section, we discuss the exclusive therapeutic approach and techniques used in occupational therapy, including Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT), Sensory Integration Techniques, and how assistive technology is used during therapy.

  5. Mental Health and Occupational Therapy: In this section of our occupational therapy course, you will learn how to deal with clients who are struggling with mental health disorders. You will get training on how to help your client restore confidence by overcoming depression and stress-related disorders.

  6. Life Events, Transition, and Loss: people encounter different types of transition or unwanted events in life that leave them devastated. In this part of our course, you will learn the coping strategies that should be applied to cope with traumas and start afresh.

  7. Professional and Personal Development: This section will focus on the tactics and training that occupational therapists should pursue to stay up-to-date in the field, as well as how to advance their careers. We will also talk about an occupational therapist's professional conduct and code of ethics.

  8. Conceptual Foundations in Practice: This section of the course will help you develop the therapeutic reasoning, critical thinking, and portfolio-building skills necessary for successful occupational therapy practice.

  9. Legislation and Advocacy: We will discuss the legal responsibilities, health policies, and advocacy strategies to support occupational therapy services. Furthermore, we will guide you on the importance of maintaining client’s privacy.

  10. Career Development and Alternative Paths: This section will provide some unique insights into occupational therapy leadership careers, professional development strategies, and the various career paths open to occupational therapists.

The Oracle 1Z0-830 certification, also known as the Java SE 21 Developer Certification, is an advanced credential that validates your expertise in modern Java development. How This Course Prepares You

This course is crafted to help you master every topic required for the Oracle 1Z0-830 certification. It includes lessons to build your understanding and quizzes to test your knowledge. By the end of the course, you’ll be well-prepared to tackle the certification exam with confidence.


Topics Covered in This Course

The Oracle 1Z0-830 certification requires proficiency across various domains of Java development.

Below is a breakdown of the topics:

1. Handling Date, Time, Text, Numeric, and Boolean Values

  • Use primitives and wrapper classes, evaluate arithmetic and boolean expressions, and apply precedence rules, type conversions, and casting.

  • Manipulate text using String, StringBuilder, and text blocks.

  • Work with date, time, duration, period, and time-zone objects, including daylight saving time, using the Date-Time API.

2. Controlling Program Flow

  • Create and manage control flow constructs such as if/else, switch statements and expressions, loops, and break/continue statements.

3. Using Object-Oriented Concepts in Java

  • Declare and instantiate objects, including nested classes, and explain object lifecycles.

  • Create classes, records, and define/instantiate instance and static fields, methods, constructors, and initializers.

  • Implement method overloading, including var-arg methods.

  • Understand variable scopes, apply encapsulation, and create immutable objects.

  • Use local variable type inference.

  • Implement inheritance, including abstract and sealed types, record classes, and overriding methods, including those of the Object class.

  • Use polymorphism, casting, and the instanceof operator with pattern matching and switch constructs.

  • Create and use interfaces with functional methods, and private, static, and default methods.

  • Work with enums including fields, methods, and constructors.

4. Handling Exceptions

  • Handle exceptions with try/catch/finally, try-with-resources, and multi-catch blocks.

  • Create and use custom exceptions.

5. Working with Arrays and Collections

  • Create and manipulate arrays, List, Set, Map, and Deque collections, including adding, removing, updating, retrieving, and sorting elements.

6. Working with Streams and Lambda Expressions

  • Use Java Streams, including lambda expressions implementing functional interfaces, to filter, transform, process, and sort data.

  • Perform decomposition, concatenation, reduction, grouping, and partitioning on sequential and parallel streams.

7. Packaging and Deploying Java Code

  • Define and expose module content, including by reflection, and declare module dependencies.

  • Compile Java code, create modular/non-modular JARs, runtime images, and implement migration to modules using unnamed/automatic modules.

8. Managing Concurrent Code Execution

  • Create platform and virtual threads using Runnable and Callable objects.

  • Manage thread lifecycles and use different ExecutorService implementations and concurrent APIs.

  • Develop thread-safe code with locking mechanisms and process Java collections concurrently with parallel streams.

9. Using Java I/O API

  • Read/write console and file data using I/O Streams.

  • Serialize and deserialize Java objects.

  • Work with Path objects and their properties using the java.nio.file API.

10. Implementing Localization

  • Implement localization using locales and resource bundles.

  • Parse and format messages, dates, times, and numbers, including currency and percentage values.

11. Additional Java Features

  • Understand the basics of the Java Logging API.

  • Use annotations like @Override, @FunctionalInterface, @Deprecated, @SuppressWarnings, and @SafeVarargs.

  1. Handling Date, Time, Text, Numeric, and Boolean Values

Kursus ini menggunakan kecerdasan buatan.

Sebagian besar tim keuangan sudah pernah mencoba alat AI. Mereka mendapat jawaban yang ditulis dengan indah, dengan satu angka salah terselip di dalamnya. Seorang atasan menemukannya, dan semuanya diam-diam kembali masuk laci.

Kursus ini adalah metode itu — pijakan sumber, verifikasi, dan jejak dokumen yang memungkinkan Anda membubuhkan nama pada hasilnya. Jika bagian itu benar, kecepatan akan datang dengan sendirinya. Jika dilewati, kecepatan tidak ada nilainya, karena Anda tidak bisa menandatangani apa pun.

Apa yang membedakan kursus ini

Sebagian besar kursus di bidang ini menjual kecepatan: bangun model dalam 30 menit, otomatiskan tutup buku bulanan, hasilkan output kelas institusi. Kursus ini memegang empat komitmen yang tidak pernah mereka pegang sekaligus:

  • Tulang punggung kendali dan audit. Pemisahan tugas ketika penyusunnya adalah mesin, batasan yang relevan dengan Undang-Undang Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) dalam tutup buku, dan persis apa yang akan pertama kali ditanyakan audit internal.

Anda mengikuti satu perusahaan — Vantera Health, perusahaan alat kesehatan yang tercatat di NASDAQ, dengan fungsi keuangan 64 orang, tutup buku delapan hari yang harus dipangkas menjadi tiga, akuisisi yang rampung di pertengahan tahun, dan investor aktivis yang mempertanyakan margin segmen.   3. Paket selisih akhir bulan yang lengkap, dengan setiap angka tertelusur ke sel sumbernya
  4. Skill tutup buku yang bisa dipakai ulang, dijalankan pada dua periode untuk membuktikan hasilnya berulang
  5. Valuasi dengan log asumsi lengkap, tiga skenario, dan tebing kovenan
  6. Agen rekonsiliasi dengan gerbang persetujuan manusia — diuji dengan mencoba membobolnya

courseDetails.longDescription:
Este curso de “Analista GRC. Gobernanza de IT, Riesgo y Cumplimiento” está diseñado para llevarte, paso a paso, desde los fundamentos hasta la práctica aplicada para que puedas desempeñarte con solvencia en roles de Analista GRC, Analista de Riesgos de Ciberseguridad o Especialista en Cumplimiento Normativo en TI.

A lo largo de las secciones recorrerás todo el ecosistema de Gobernanza, Riesgo y Cumplimiento (GRC – Governance, Risk & Compliance) aplicado a la ciberseguridad:

  • Empezarás por la tecnología y la ciberseguridad desde cero, entendiendo conceptos clave, la triada CIA (Confidentiality, Integrity, Availability – Confidencialidad, Integridad, Disponibilidad) y cómo se conectan con GRC.

  • Verás disciplinas, roles y carreras dentro de GRC, las tres líneas de defensa y cómo se organiza un área de riesgo y cumplimiento dentro de empresas tecnológicas.

  • Profundizarás en Gobernanza de IT: políticas, estándares y procedimientos, comités, responsabilidades, alineación con el negocio y cómo se baja una política a controles concretos en el día a día.

Después entrarás en el corazón del curso:

  • Ciberseguridad y cumplimiento normativo: ISO/IEC 27001, ISO/IEC 27005, NIST CSF, PCI DSS, CIS Controls, GDPR, HIPAA, DORA, SOX, SOC y otros marcos que hoy piden las empresas, entendiendo su alcance, requisitos y relación con el negocio.

  • Gestión de riesgos de TI: terminología, fuentes de vulnerabilidades, proceso completo de gestión de riesgos, evaluación cualitativa y cuantitativa, matrices de impacto y probabilidad, respuesta al riesgo, monitoreo, reporte ejecutivo y riesgo de terceros.

  • Compliance en acción: cómo demostrar cumplimiento, evidencias, controles internos, reportes y relación con auditorías internas y externas.

La gran diferencia de este programa es su enfoque 100 % práctico:

  • Estudiarás casos reales tipo “mini-consultoría”: implementación de PCI DSS 4.0 en un e-commerce, ISO 27001 en un proveedor cloud, NIST CSF y CIS Controls en una empresa financiera, GDPR y HIPAA en organizaciones con datos sensibles, y DORA aplicado a entidades del sector financiero.

  • Verás controles concretos de seguridad: gestión de identidades y accesos (MFA, SSO, RBAC, cuentas privilegiadas), segmentación de redes, firewalls, IDS/IPS, EDR y seguridad de endpoints, inventario de activos, gestión de cambios y parches, ciclo seguro de desarrollo (SDLC seguro) y evaluación de vulnerabilidades con CVSS.

  • Trabajarás con el enfoque de pre-auditoría GRC, simulando la revisión junto al CISO (Chief Information Security Officer – Director de Seguridad de la Información) y preparando la organización para auditorías formales.

Al finalizar podrás:

  • Entender y explicar con claridad cómo se conectan gobernanza, riesgo y cumplimiento con la estrategia del negocio.

  • Leer, interpretar y bajar a la práctica los principales estándares y marcos de referencia de ciberseguridad y cumplimiento.

  • Participar en proyectos de implementación de marcos y normas (ISO 27001, PCI DSS, NIST CSF, CIS, GDPR, HIPAA, DORA, SOX, SOC, entre otros).

  • Colaborar en procesos de gestión de riesgos de TI, desde la identificación hasta el seguimiento de planes de tratamiento.

  • Aportar valor en áreas de GRC, Seguridad de la Información, Auditoría de TI, Riesgo Operacional y Cumplimiento.

¿Para quién es este curso?

  • Personas que quieren iniciar o hacer transición de carrera hacia GRC, gestión de riesgos o ciberseguridad.

  • Profesionales de TI, seguridad, auditoría, legal o compliance que necesitan una visión integral y práctica.

  • Estudiantes o recién graduados que buscan potenciar su perfil para roles de Analista de Riesgos o Analista GRC.

¿Qué necesitas?

  • Conocimientos básicos de informática son suficientes.

  • No se requiere experiencia previa en GRC ni en ciberseguridad; el curso te lleva de lo fundamental a lo práctico de forma progresiva.
targetAudiences: toda persona interesada en aprender grc

Inscríbete hoy y empieza a transformar tu forma de trabajar con automatizaciones sin código.

courseDetails.title: SMART Goals Parenting
courseDetails.shortDescription: 5 Skills to Parenting Healthier and Easier. Bye-Bye Power Struggles!
courseDetails.longDescription:
Many parents describe the desires for their children as "I want my kids to be happy" or "I want them to have a good life." But these goals are abstract and difficult to achieve once, let alone repeat.


SMART Goals Parenting breaks these (and other) abstract desires down into their basic foundational components that allow you and your child to achieve happiness, connection, trust and respect... repeatedly.


SMART Goals Parenting's objective is to provide you with the knowledge and tools to cultivate your desired relationship with your child while also preparing your child for being able to one day cultivate happiness and success for him/herself.

You will learn the two SMART goals, which will be your guiding lights are you traverse the terrain of parenthood.


As long as you maintain your focus on what you are ultimately trying to achieve you won't get lost in the minutia.

After learning the SMART goals you will learn how to identify and avoid the pitfalls of choosing fear over love and discarding self-care.


Engaging in these two behaviors will sabotage all of your work. It will be like pouring water into a bottle with no bottom. If you have ever felt unappreciated, unloved, disrespected or criticized for your parenting efforts then I am certain one or both of these barriers are at play.

The next few lessons will tackle guidance.


My goal is to get you to the point when guiding your child is a simple conversation in which both of you feel understood and respected. Until then, you may need these skills to help you navigate.


Choices, Consequences, Rewards and Reinforce (CCRR) are the four parts of seamless discipline.


Streamline how you discipline and remove all power struggles. Doing so will solidify you as your child's respected figure and someone s/he can look up to.


The last, but not least topics covered are the most used parts of communication - listening and speaking. You should listen to understand and speak to build trust.


Many Parents, Myself included have practiced these, eliminating Parenting Stress, following Structured Guidance, helping to Raise Healthy, Confident and Motivated Children.


I look forward to helping you do the same.


Best regards,

Helen V Hicks MA MBA LPC

Licensed Professional Counselor, Parenting Coach
targetAudiences: Parents or caregivers of children aged 1 to 17 years old
